title: Composition record
description: Machine-readable shape of a task-driven page composition. Interpretive operational guidance, secondary to official DGA sources and verified extractions. Structure only: no visual-theme, color, or styling fields.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier matching the folder name.

status.description: Provenance status; interpretive operational guidance only.

purpose.description: One-line statement of what the composition organizes.

suitableFor.description: Task/context situations where this composition fits.

unsuitableFor.description: Situations where this composition should not be used.

primaryTask.description: The single user task the composition is built around.

dominantElement.description: The one region/element that must own the screen.

navigationModel.description: How the user moves within/through the composition.

responsiveBehavior.description: How the structure transforms across breakpoints (structure, not styling).

accessibilityRequirements.description: Structure-level accessibility requirements (landmarks, order, focus, RTL).

suitableComponents.description: Component categories that populate the regions (categories, not code).

variationDimensions.description: Structural dimensions along which variants may differ.

relatedCompositions.description: Ids of adjacent compositions and when to switch to them.

variants.description: Optional list of structurally distinct variant names for this composition.
